instruction: Write bpftrace script for disk I/O tracing
output:
<think>
The user wants to write bpftrace script for disk I/O tracing.
I'd use cat for this — cat operations.
I'll check the output to make sure it did what we expected.
</think>
cat > /tmp/diskio.bt << 'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/bpftrace
kprobe:blk_account_io_start
{
    @start[tid] = nsecs;
    @size = args->rq_sectors;
}
kprobe:blk_account_io_completion
/tid in @start/
{
    $us = (nsecs - @start[tid]) / 1000;
    printf("disk I/O: %d sectors, %d us\n", @size, $us);
    delete(@start[tid]);
    delete(@size);
}
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/diskio.bt
